web/radiology-structured.css.before: .rad-structured{border:1px solid var(--border,#555);border-radius:10px;padding:20px;margin:24px 0;min-width:0}.rad-structured details{border-top:1px solid #7775;padding:12px 0}.rad-structured summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5}.rad-structured label{display:block;margin:12px 0}.rad-structured label>span{display:block;margin-bottom:5px}.rad-structured input:not([type=checkbox]),.rad-structured select,.rad-structured textarea{width:100%;max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;font:inherit;padding:9px;border:1px solid #7777;border-radius:5px;color:inherit;background:transparent}.rad-structured small{display:block;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;opacity:.8}.rad-structured textarea{min-height:170px;margin:16px 0;white-space:pre-wrap}.rad-structured pre{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}.rad-structured a{display:block;margin:8px 0}.rad-structured [hidden]{display:none!important}
